# Biblicon

> Biblicon pairs every passage of the four Gospels (Matthew, Mark, Luke and John, King James
> Version) with an Eastern Orthodox icon of the scene and with commentary quoted verbatim from
> the Church Fathers venerated in the Orthodox Church.

## About

- Name: Biblicon
- Type: Bible-study reader / Eastern Orthodox icon reader for the four Gospels
- Content: KJV Gospel text, Eastern Orthodox iconography, patristic commentary
- Format: four self-contained readers, one per Gospel; each also works fully offline
  (double-click, no server, no network required)

## The four readers

- Matthew: 28 chapters, 120 passages, 112 icons, 360 patristic quotations
- Mark: 16 chapters, 104 passages, 80 icons, 300 patristic quotations
- Luke: 24 chapters, 152 passages, 89 icons, 455 patristic quotations
- John: 21 chapters, 64 passages, 73 icons, 192 patristic quotations

Every quotation names its own Father (restricted to those venerated in the Orthodox Church) and
the specific homily or work it is drawn from. Every icon carries positioned markers identifying
its details ("Deciphering the Icon").

## Source

Source code and full build pipeline: https://github.com/anthonus123/biblicon
